name: Exp_EMA_Prediction
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom EMA_Prediction indicator, which uses two EMAs (fast and slow) to predict price direction. It opens buy positions on upward prediction signals and sell positions on downward prediction signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position closing logic. The EA supports multiple money management modes and allows independent control of entry and exit for both long and short positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义EMA_Prediction指标的信号进行交易，该指标使用快速和慢速两条EMA线来预测价格方向。当出现向上预测信号时开多仓，出现向下预测信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损止盈及仓位关闭逻辑。EA支持多种资金管理模式，并允许独立控制多头和空头的入场与出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于EMA预测指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当EMA_Prediction指标的上行信号线（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时开多仓；当下行信号线（buffer 0）产生非零且非空值时开空仓。出场条件：当指标在历史柱中反向出现信号时触发平仓，同时也通过固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit参数进行止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数五种模式。EA还实现了新柱检测机制以避免同一柱内重复开仓，并在信号柱为零时允许每tick都进行信号检查。当同时启用开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史柱寻找更早的反向信号来决定是否平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the EMA_Prediction indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upward signal line (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar; a sell position is opened when the downward signal line (buffer 0) produces a non-zero, non-empty value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when the indicator produces a reverse signal on historical bars, and also through fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five modes: by free margin, by balance, by free margin after losses, by balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, and allows per-tick signal checking when the signal bar is set to zero. When both entry and exit are enabled and no current close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for closing decisions.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: Free margin/Balance/Balance after loss/Fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的柱索引

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，便于策略优化和只做单边行情
实现了新柱检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
止损止盈参数完整，风险控制框架基本健全
信号重计机制（Recount）提高了指标数据读取的容错性
pros_en: Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility to accommodate different risk preferences
Buy and sell entry/exit can be independently controlled, facilitating strategy optimization and directional bias filtering
Implements new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries within the same candle, reducing overtrading
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide a fundamentally sound risk control framework
Signal recount mechanism (Recount flag) improves fault tolerance for indicator data reading
cons: 快速EMA周期为1、慢速EMA周期为2，参数极小容易产生大量虚假信号和过度交易
历史柱回溯平仓逻辑效率低下，可能遍历大量历史数据且平仓信号滞后严重
缺少点差过滤、交易时间限制和最大持仓数控制等风控措施
依赖自定义指标EMA_Prediction，该指标必须单独编译部署，增加了维护复杂度
没有追踪止损或移动止损功能，盈利单可能在回撤中损失大部分利润
cons_en: Fast EMA period of 1 and slow EMA period of 2 are extremely small, likely generating excessive false signals and overtrading
Historical bar backtracking exit logic is inefficient, potentially iterating through large amounts of data and delivering delayed close signals
Lacks spread filter, trading session restrictions, and maximum position count controls as risk management measures
Depends on the custom EMA_Prediction indicator which must be separately compiled and deployed, increasing maintenance complexity
No trailing stop or breakeven functionality, meaning profitable positions may lose most gains during pullbacks
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在点差过大或低流动性时段开仓
优化历史柱回溯平仓逻辑，限制回溯深度或改用基于ATR的动态止损替代
增加追踪止损和保本止损功能，更好地保护浮动盈利
建议将EMA周期默认值调整为更合理的数值（如8和21），减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid entries during high spread or low liquidity periods
Optimize historical bar backtracking exit logic by limiting lookback depth or replacing with ATR-based dynamic stops
Add trailing stop and breakeven functionality to better protect unrealized profits
Recommend adjusting default EMA periods to more reasonable values (e.g., 8 and 21) to reduce false signals

risk_points: EMA周期为1和2时信号极其频繁，可能导致过度交易和高交易成本
历史柱回溯平仓逻辑可能在强趋势中延迟平仓，导致不必要的亏损
缺少点差过滤，在高点差时段开仓可能直接亏损
risk_points_en: EMA periods of 1 and 2 generate extremely frequent signals, potentially causing overtrading and high transaction costs
Historical bar backtracking exit logic may delay position closing during strong trends, leading to unnecessary losses
Lack of spread filter may result in immediate losses when opening positions during high spread periods
